mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 3-year rolling walk-forward tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate revenue expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1100.0 and RSAFS > 450000.0 in the same month
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST > 1100 and RSAFS > 450000) produces positive 60-day returns in < 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 98.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals weakening economic momentum and triggers risk-off behavior, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 2.5% annually, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals that the Fed is maintaining a restrictive monetary stance, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS >= 0.37%) results in positive 20-day returns in > 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is negative in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (proxy: RSAFS) combined with rising GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS > 450000 and GDPC1 > 16500.0) produces positive 60-day returns in < 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% and a rise in non-farm payrolls above 200k signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 200.0) results in negative 20-day returns in < 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 98.0, combined with a rising unemployment rate above 5.0%, indicates a supply-side contraction coupled with weakening labor demand, signaling an imminent economic downturn and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO < 98.0 and UNRATE > 5.0) produces negative 5-day returns in < 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
